source.note: Source polygons are not official or legal boundaries. Coverage and names are incomplete and span different periods.

limitations: Historical local snapshot, not a live polygon-by-polygon comparison against current Native Land Digital; no new territory data downloaded.
Numerical error measures projection precision, not survey accuracy or verification of affiliation.
Geometry changes limited to existing documented territory-fixes.js; all resulting coordinates checked against original feature or broadOf ID.
